newsitem.title: USA: New York sets Conrail merger hearings.
newsitem.headline: New York sets Conrail merger hearings.

text.p: The New York State Department of Transportation said Thursday it will conduct three hearings across the state on the potential impacts of a merger of the Consolidated Rail Corp with another rail freight carrier.
It said the hearings will be held:
March 6 in Albany at Empire State Plaza, Meeting Room 3, Concourse Level, starting 1000 EST/1500 GMT.
March 7 In Buffalo at the Buffalo and Erie County Library, 2nd Floor, Lafayette Square, starting 1000.
March 13 in New York City in the Oval Room, 44th Floor, One World Trade Center, Starting 4 p.m.
With over 2000 miles of track, Conrail currently is the primary rail freight carrier in New York, serving all the state's major cities, the department pointed out.
It said the testimony will be used to develop a state position to be presented to the U.S. Surface Transportation Board, which is responsible for the final approval of all rail mergers in the nation.
